Title (L1) leads with the neutral topic name, not a failure word; the opening paragraph (L3) states the failure framing ('mostly wrong') only to correct it into the positive discipline ('the real story is about quality... signal-to-noise', L7). Every craft-section header is a verb-led positive discipline, not a failure word: 'Start clean' (L41), 'Pass paths, not paste' (L43), 'Subagent as a firewall' (L49), 'Route by complexity, not price' (L51), 'Keep what you carry lean' (L53).

M3 carries the first Skill use + first subagent + first authoring together') — it mirrors M1's own already-sanctioned pre-exposure via the optional Cherny-talk read, which the strategy doc itself credits with 'subagent map-reduce' by inclusion (L292). (e) Re-checked the one sequencing concern a superseded prior instance of this file raised: that the folklore section's Amp compaction/Handoff-reversal story (L67-69, sourced from amp-handoff/amp-neo) might front-run M5's closing lecture.
